answer_1.quote: We evaluate our approach on three benchmarks: 1. RewardBench : comprehensive evaluation of helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty. 2. MT-Bench : multi-turn instruction-following across diverse domains. 3. Keyword-Constrained Generation Task: specifically designed for this study, requiring incorporation of specific keywords while maintaining coherence, testing flexible token selection...
answer_1.outputs: generated responses to prompts, multi-turn dialogues, keyword-constrained texts, code

answer_2.quote: Additional standard metrics such as Win Rate and Perplexity are also employed.

answer_3.quote: For multi-turn dialogue evaluations using MT-Bench, we employ GPT-4.1 (OpenAI API) as a judge model to determine which of two provided responses is of higher quality.
